push.title: W 4-2 vs Inter Aliens | You: 9.1 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
A 9.1 against Inter Aliens, PhogsToffees. Your 3rd best match performance, and it felt like it.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Inter Aliens's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ 2 key passes. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. MOTM. Put it on the fridge and the resume.
+ Feeding tuxedo_slide like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ That's your 3rd best match performance with a 9.1. Proud doesn't cover it.

THE BAD
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 2 (best was BellyTb1's 3). Repeat after me: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- Most giveaways on the team: 9 (best was tuxedo_slide's 6). One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Shots on target: 75%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 90%+.

Practice prescription: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

You were a pleasure tonight. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs Inter Aliens | You: 8.1 (3rd best match performance)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.1. That's what showing up looks like, and it looks good on you.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 17%). You timed it like a grandfather clock.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Making chances is a gift, and you were Santa Claus tonight.
+ A brace against Inter Aliens, your first since Sep 30. You put it where Grandma keeps the good cookies: right on the top shelf.
+ Pass accuracy 74%, up from your usual 50%. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ PhogsToffees scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.

THE BAD
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. My two cents: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was PhogsToffees's 2). Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 19 (best was BellyTb1's 30). Mark my words: Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
- 4 shots off target: -0.1. Next match, nail it.
- Tackles attempted: 3. A good number on the way to 6+.

Rondo time: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked.

tuxedo_slide, take this with you: Football's like a casserole. Everybody brings something.

Keep that fire burning. - Coach Lasso
